policyText: No payment now. If you cancel less than 1 hour before your appointment, or don't come, Izzy Clipz may charge $55–$60 (100% of the service) to this card. Cancelling in the app more than 1 hour before is free.

warning.title: Full Service Cancellation & No-Show Fee
warning.message: Cancelling less than 1 hour before your appointment, or not showing up, is charged the full service price ($55–$60). Cancelling in the app more than 1 hour before is free.
